tests.notes: Three filesystem capability skips and one Windows symlink capability skip. Includes path-limit preflight and Python launcher regression tests.

limitations: Fresh ZIP install used already installed dependencies on the development PC.
Other isolated Folklore controllers owned the GPU; this task did not interrupt them.
Build and launcher readiness do not establish gameplay, visual quality, performance or campaign correctness.
Game executable, generated game source, assets, firmware, saves and NVIDIA development DLL are not distributed.
publication_note: The final package may add documentation/receipt-only changes; all engine/client bytes must match the tested source snapshot.
